about_the_game:
Welcome to a turn-based, tactical 3D shooter where your mind is your greatest weapon. You are a lone survivor, fighting your way out of a high-security facility after stealing a powerful secret. Every machine in this automated fortress is hunting you down. Brute force won't save you—survival depends on your ability to outwit the AI, one strategic turn at a time.

The key to your escape is the 'Stack'. Before each encounter, you'll fabricate bullet and load your ammunition. The fate lies not in what you fabricate, but in the precise order you load it in. This sequence is your battle plan. Will you start your turn with a Fire round to melt armor, follow with a Corrosion round to expose a weakness, and then finish with a Basic round? The battlefield is a puzzle, and your Stack is the key.

This is a battle of wits, not reflexes. Analyze the battlefield, predict enemy actions, and execute the perfect sequence of shots from your Stack to neutralize robotic threats and control the fight.

Your journey is a calculated cycle: Shop to build your arsenal, Plan your Stack for the upcoming fight, and Battle through turn-based encounters. Each cleared room brings you one step closer to freedom.

Face a diverse army of robotic sentinels, from nimble drones to heavily armored security units. You must adapt your tactics and fine-tune your Stack to counter every new challenge the AI throws at you.

Immerse yourself in a cold, post-apocalyptic world brought to life with 3D graphics. This is a pure, focused tactical experience—just you, your weapon, and a series of complex combat puzzles to solve.

Can you devise the perfect strategy and dismantle the machine to win your freedom?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7, 8, 10 or later, 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Phenom II X4
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 750
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 768 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060

short_description: StacKit is a turn-based puzzle of pure strategy. Load your gun in a precise order before you fight—this is your 'Stack'. Once in combat, your firing sequence is locked. Use Fire to strip armor, then hit with Corrosion to weaken foes and boost all other damage.
